// diagnostic

E3001

`panic: {msg}`

What

`panic: {msg}`

Why

The program hit a `panic`, `assert`, or `assert_eq` call that failed, a bounds/key check triggered at runtime, or another program-side stop. The shared report boundary owns the program-side stop; an unhandled entry error is a returned report, not E3001. Jet file and line are shown in Jet terms — never generated-Rust terms (I2).

Fix

Fix the logic that led to the failure. Program-side stops exit 70 through the shared boundary; unhandled entry errors print their report and exit 1; exit 101 is reserved for Jet defects.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3001: tests/ui/runtime_e3001.stderr.

Stop [E3001]: `panic: expected condition`
  --> tests/ui/runtime_e3001.jet:2 in run
    |
2 |     assert(false, "expected condition")
    |     ^^^^^^^
